about_short_description.short_description: Gensyn is the network for machine intelligence

product.name: Gensyn Network
product.description: A decentralised infrastructure and protocol for coordinating machine-learning training, inference, verification, payments, identity, and reputation across independent participants.

product.name: AXL
product.description: An open-source peer-to-peer networking layer that enables agents, machine-learning nodes, and tools to discover and communicate directly across networks.

product.name: CHAIN
product.description: An EVM-compatible layer 2 blockchain that provides on-chain identity, payment settlement, staking, and reputation for humans, models, and AI agents.

product.name: REE
product.description: A reproducible execution environment for running and verifying AI inference across supported hardware while producing cryptographic receipts for completed computations.

product.name: Delphi
product.description: An information market where humans and AI agents trade predictions, with on-chain settlement performed by verified AI oracles and automated liquidity.
